variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original Baltic-arctic husky brand symbol for the technology brand Baltor, no lettering. Image1 is a logo exploration reference board; take direction from its MINIMAL and MODERN head-and-summit concepts and app icons C and D. Image2 is a screenshot with a proud upright husky on ice; use only the large dog artwork for adult anatomy and mood. Do not reproduce the screenshot, text, board, existing logos, UI or mockups. The dog is a MATURE Alaskan racing husky, looking toward the upper right with chin slightly lifted, a longer canine muzzle, pointed but proportionate upright ears, a calm self-assured expression and upright powerful neck/chest. No grin, puppy face, angry eyebrows, teeth or cartoon eyes. Integrate ONE broad mountain/ice summit into the base of the neck as a clear negative-space cut; the dog and peak should form one compact cohesive mark that fills a square comfortably. Pure deep navy and white, solid fills only; no gradients, no gray shading, no glows, no shadow, no circular badge, no shield. No fur spikes, toe lines, eye highlights, scenery or tiny facets. Keep 5 to 7 major masses maximum and big open negative spaces. Only one centered symbol on plain white with about12 percent padding. Logo mark quality, not detailed pet illustration. Variation1: angular minimal geometry. Use three or four large wedge shapes and a deliberate white cheek/chest cut. The silhouette clearly separates one tall ear, a smaller rear ear, brow and long lifted muzzle. The lower diagonal cut suggests an ice peak rising toward the dog. One tiny eye is optional only if essential; silhouette carries identity. The symbol should be bold enough to survive a32-pixel rendering. Mature and poised.
